request:
I sell provisions at Makola market and I want to keep track of my stock. For each item I want to save its name, how many I have, and the level at which I consider it to be running low. When I sell some of an item the quantity should go down, but I must not be able to sell more than I have. When new goods arrive I record a restock and the quantity goes up. The amount sold or restocked must always be more than zero. I want to see all my items, look at one item, and see a list of the items that are at or below their low level so I know what to buy.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: Are quantities always whole numbers (like 5 tins), or do you sometimes sell part amounts (like 1.5 kg of rice)?
A: Whole numbers only. Each item's quantity and low level are whole numbers.
Q: Do you want a saved history of each sale and restock with the date, or only the current quantity?
A: No history needed now. Only the current quantity matters.
Q: Should you be able to change an item's name or low level later, or remove an item you no longer sell?
A: No preference: you decide.
summary:
I've built your stock tracker in `app.py`, and I wrote 23 automated tests that check everything you asked for. All of them pass. Your stock is saved in a file called `stock.db` in the project folder.

**What you can do:**

| Action | Address | What you send |
|---|---|---|
| Add a new item | `POST /items` | name, quantity, low level |
| See all items | `GET /items` | — |
| Look at one item | `GET /items/{id}` | — |
| See items at or below their low level | `GET /items/low` | — |
| Record a sale | `POST /items/{id}/sell` | amount |
| Record a restock | `POST /items/{id}/restock` | amount |

When you add an item it gets a number (its id), and you use that number to look at it, sell it or restock it. Each time you sell or restock, you get the item back showing its new quantity.

**What the app refuses:**
- **Selling more than you have:** refused, and the quantity stays the same.
- **A sale or restock amount that is zero, negative or not a whole number** (like 1.5): refused.
- **An item with no name, a negative quantity or low level, or a quantity or low level that isn't a whole number:** refused.
- **Using an item number that doesn't exist:** you get a "not found" message.

**Things to know:**
- **No editing or removing items:** you said you had no preference, so I kept it to what you asked for. You can't yet change an item's name or low level, or remove an item. I can add that if you want it.
- **Don't run the tests on your real stock:** the tests use the same `stock.db` file and clear it before each test. Running them would wipe any stock you've saved, so only run them before you start entering real items.
